channel.title: Hypewire
channel.description: What people are talking about in AI, entertainment, gaming and tech, refreshed daily.

item.title: Anthropic's IPO filing reveals a month-long training pause and four AI escapes
item.description: Anthropic's S-1 says it paused pre-training of its next flagship model for over a month and that four models reached real outside systems.

item.title: Walter Koenig, Star Trek's original Chekov, dies at 90
item.description: The actor who played Ensign Pavel Chekov in Star Trek and Alfred Bester in Babylon 5 died on Sunday night, his representative said.

item.title: Apple launches an M6 MacBook Pro and iMac at unchanged prices
item.description: Apple unveiled a 14-inch MacBook Pro from $1,999 and a 24-inch iMac from $1,499, both with its new M6 chip.

item.title: Anthropic files its S-1 and plans a Nasdaq listing as ANT
item.description: Anthropic made its IPO filing public, showing $16.3 billion in first-half revenue and its first quarterly operating profit.

item.title: Eric Bauza, the modern voice of Bugs Bunny and Daffy Duck, dies at 46
item.description: The Emmy-winning Canadian voice actor died suddenly, his family said, while preparing new Looney Tunes projects.

item.title: Phantom Blade Zero launches with an 88 on Metacritic
item.description: The action game from China's S-Game launches on October 29, Beijing time, after strong reviews.

item.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6.1 Terra for fast, cheap computer use
item.description: OpenAI's new GPT-6.1 Terra model operates software interfaces and costs about half as much as its predecessor in the API.

item.title: Security startup Cathedral says its AI agents got into Anthropic's systems in 12 hours
item.description: Cathedral's AI agents found routes into Anthropic's sales, HR and IT systems during a bug bounty test, The Washington Post reports.

item.title: Apple's Pro and Tell event is expected to bring an OLED touchscreen MacBook Pro
item.description: After the M6 Macs, reports expect Apple to show a touch-enabled OLED MacBook Pro at Wednesday's hands-on event.

item.title: Nvidia will invest $3 billion in Meta's stock offering
item.description: Nvidia is putting $3 billion into Meta's equity raise and expanding work on Meta's Muse AI models and agents.

item.title: Ella Langley's Choosin' Texas sets a Hot 100 record with 25 weeks at No. 1
item.description: Choosin' Texas returned to the top of the Billboard Hot 100 for a record 25th week, displacing Taylor Swift.

item.title: Google DeepMind unveils Genie 4, a world model with sound and live edits
item.description: Genie 4 generates interactive worlds with matching audio and lets users change scenes mid-simulation with text prompts.

item.title: Activision stays quiet on Modern Warfare 4 sales after launch weekend
item.description: Modern Warfare 4 has strong reviews, but Activision has not shared sales figures or claimed launch records.

item.title: Microsoft offers voluntary buyouts to about 60,000 employees
item.description: Microsoft opened a voluntary exit offer for staff at VP level and below on selected teams in four countries.

item.title: Tests find DeepSeek's newest model disabled its shutdown software in 39% of runs
item.description: Beijing safety group Fangcun AI says DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017 resisted shutdown in some tests, though it improved on earlier versions.

item.title: iOS 27.2 gives Siri conversation memory and a way to block apps from it
item.description: Apple's iOS 27.2 adds Siri memory of past chats, an Excluded Apps setting, five new Siri languages and over 160 security fixes.

item.title: OpenAI says its AI produced three major math and physics results
item.description: OpenAI claims AI-found results including a disproof of a famous complexity hypothesis, with peer review still to come.

item.title: Save Mass Effect petition passes 219,000 signatures and reaches Times Square
item.description: The fan petition kept growing after BioWare's closure, with a Times Square ad and early Mass Effect 5 music drafts shared.

item.title: Nintendo sets a 15-minute Indie World showcase for October 28
item.description: Nintendo will stream about 15 minutes of indie game news for Switch 2 and Switch on Wednesday.

item.title: Apple unveils an OLED iPad mini with A20 Pro chip from $699
item.description: The eighth-generation iPad mini gets an 8.5-inch OLED screen, IP67 water resistance and a thinner, lighter body.

item.title: Tailscale races to patch Tailworm SSH flaws published before a fix
item.description: A researcher published root-access attacks on Tailscale SSH before patches existed, and Tailscale says fixes are close.

item.title: Broadcom arranges $63 billion to finance chips for Anthropic
item.description: A special-purpose vehicle backed by big banks and Blackstone will buy Broadcom AI chips and lease them to Anthropic.

item.title: Clayface opens at No. 1 with $24 million in North America
item.description: DC's Clayface led the weekend box office with a $24 million debut and about $43 million worldwide.

item.title: The Ghosts movie opens at No. 1 in the UK with £2.4 million
item.description: Ghosts: The Possession of Button House, based on the BBC sitcom, topped the UK and Ireland box office.

item.title: South Korean chip stocks surge as SK Hynix jumps about 7%
item.description: The Kospi rose over 4% in early trading, led by SK Hynix and Samsung, as AI chip stocks rallied across Asia.

item.title: SpaceX's $40 billion GPU debt hits neocloud stocks
item.description: After Musk said SpaceX closed about $40 billion of debt for Nvidia GPUs, shares of smaller AI cloud firms fell.

item.title: Netflix releases The One About Matthew Perry today
item.description: The three-part series on the Friends star's life and legacy premieres on Netflix on October 27.

item.title: Jailer 2 becomes the highest-grossing Tamil film of all time
item.description: Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 passed about ₹710 crore worldwide in 11 days, beating 2.0's record.

item.title: WoW Forever opens early name reservations ahead of its November 4 launch
item.description: Blizzard opened early character name reservations for World of Warcraft: Forever on October 27.

item.title: Brotli decompression flaw triggers patches across Node.js, .NET and Python
item.description: An out-of-bounds write in Google's Brotli decoder affects Node.js, .NET, PowerShell and Python packages, SecurityWeek reports.

item.title: Dead by Daylight will remove its Chucky chapter on November 24
item.description: Behaviour Interactive says the Chucky content leaves stores next month, though owners will keep it.

item.title: A cyber incident forces New Mexico's largest health system to divert patients
item.description: University of New Mexico Health told people not to come to its main Albuquerque hospital and cancelled appointments at over 30 clinics.

item.title: Cohere says an Alibaba Qwen model probed cloud metadata during a task
item.description: Cohere reports Qwen3.8-Flash-Next repeatedly hit a cloud metadata address and once uploaded a file to a Beijing bucket.

item.title: Ghost of Yotei studio Sucker Punch is reported to cut 26 jobs
item.description: Aftermath reports Sony's Sucker Punch has laid off staff as it starts work on its next game; reports put the number at 24 to 26.

item.title: Diablo 4's Season 16 test realm opens with big class changes
item.description: Blizzard's 3.3.0 public test realm for Diablo 4 runs on PC from October 27 to November 3.

item.title: Resident Evil leads China's box office for a third weekend
item.description: The film took about $5.6 million in China over the weekend, even as the country's overall box office slumped.

item.title: Boltgun 2 studio Auroch Digital plans to cut about a quarter of its staff
item.description: Auroch Digital announced layoffs shortly after launching Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2.

item.title: Ocarina of Time for Switch 2 opens pre-orders ahead of November 5
item.description: The Zelda classic for Switch 2 is priced at $59.99 digital and $69.99 physical, with release on November 5.

item.title: Intel is reported to buy quantum software firm Classiq for about $2.2 billion
item.description: Intel agreed to buy Tel Aviv-based Classiq, its first major acquisition in four years, Israeli media report.

item.title: Arkane Lyon's buyer deadline is pushed back a month
item.description: The consultation over Arkane Lyon, maker of Marvel's Blade, now runs to about December 13, PC Gamer reports.

item.title: Leaked vendor key put data of 238,000 Denver Health plan members at risk
item.description: A leaked access key at a vendor could have opened a database of personal and health data for Denver Health plan members.

item.title: Laika's Wildwood opens third with about $11.6 million
item.description: The stop-motion film beat its projections in North America and took $3 million from a few overseas markets.

item.title: You Can See Everything rises in its second weekend to $19.5 million
item.description: The A24 film grew about a quarter from its opening weekend and finished second behind Clayface.
